title: Rhythm-TTS: High-Fidelity Shortcut Latent Modeling and Probabilistic Rhythm Generation for Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech
abstract: arXiv:2510.02848v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) systems are commonly built on either discrete codec tokens or continuous acoustic representations. Discrete-token models benefit from stable sequence modeling and explicit speech factorization, but they ultimately synthesize speech through codebook lookup and codeword composition, which can accumulate errors and impose a quality ceiling on naturalness and speaker similarity. Continuous-representation models can generate fine-grained speech latents directly, but often require heavier in-context modeling and less explicit alignment. This paper presents \textbf{Rhythm-TTS}, a shortcut zero-shot TTS framework that combines the factorizability of discrete codec tokens with the fidelity of continuous latent generation. translated_title: Rhythm-TTS：面向零样本文本转语音的高保真捷径潜变量建模与概率化节奏生成
translated_abstract: 零样本文本转语音（TTS）系统通常建立在离散编解码器标记（codec tokens）或连续声学表示之上。离散标记模型受益于稳定的序列建模和显式的语音因子分解，但其最终通过码本查找和码字组合来合成语音，这会累积误差并对自然度和说话人相似度造成质量上限。连续表示模型可以直接生成细粒度的语音潜变量，但往往需要更繁重的上下文建模且对齐不够显式。本文提出 Rhythm-TTS，一种捷径（shortcut）零样本文本转语音框架，它将离散编解码器标记的可因子分解性与连续潜变量生成的高保真度相结合。Rhythm-TTS 不把预测出的编解码器标记直接作为最终声学表示，而是将其用作语义-声学先验，并直接生成整体的连续语音潜变量……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: Rhythm-TTS 提出了一种捷径零样本文本转语音框架，将预测的离散编解码器标记作为语义-声学先验，直接生成高保真的整体连续语音潜变量，并结合概率化节奏生成，从而兼顾离散标记的可因子分解性与连续表示的高保真度。
en_tdlr: Rhythm-TTS combines the factorizability of discrete codec tokens with the fidelity of continuous latent generation by using predicted codec tokens as a semantic-acoustic prior to directly generate holistic high-fidelity continuous speech latents, with probabilistic rhythm modeling, for zero-shot text-to-speech.
